# hetznerrobot_ip_cancellation (Data Source)

Reads the cancellation data of a IP address. Fails when the IP address cannot be cancelled (e.g. a server's main IP).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_ip_cancellation" "vm" {
  ip = "123.123.123.125"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The IP address (for a subnet: its net address).

### Read-Only

- `cancellation_date` (String) Date of the active cancellation; null when none is active.
- `cancelled` (Boolean) Whether a cancellation is active.
- `earliest_cancellation_date` (String) Earliest possible cancellation date.
- `server_number` (Number) Server the IP address belongs to.
